name: folha-controltax
description: Folha de pagamento da ControlTax — substituto do módulo Folha/DP do Domínio

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @folha/calculo && concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @folha/api" "npm run dev -w @folha/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @folha/calculo && npm run build -w @folha/web && npm run build -w @folha/api
scripts.test: npm run build -w @folha/calculo && npm test -w @folha/calculo && npm test -w @folha/api
